rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a Day-5 full blastocyst and fair TE/good ICM concept, but it misstates the provided Gardner grade by calling TE B when 2AB means ICM A and TE B only if using standard order; it also adds uncertain image-based claims such as graininess/collapse and is not fully precise about expansion.
Thoroughly integrates age, PCOS/AMH, low MII yield, prior IVF outcomes including live birth/miscarriage, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and future planning.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with the implantation estimate tied to morphology, age, and lifestyle factors; minor issue is the grading interpretation inconsistency around ICM/TE quality.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer at age 34, smoking/alcohol cessation, luteal support adherence, cavity review if recurrent failure, individualized PGT-A discussion. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative emphasis on endometrial thickness and protocol suggestions without stronger qualification.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, lifestyle modification, nutritional supplementation, review of trigger/protocol, metabolic workup, cavity assessment, and consideration of FET/PGT-A if failures recur.
